input.title: Non-US market to shorten stock settlement to T+1 in 2028
input.summary: A non-US market (source: Korean outlet 아시아경제) is reported to be shortening its stock settlement cycle to T+1 in 2028, with sellers to receive proceeds the next day. No link to US markets, DTCC, NSCC or DTC is stated in the article.
